name: EvalBiasBench
description: EvalBiasBench is a meta-evaluation collection of hand-crafted test cases designed to identify and evaluate six types of biases inherent in judge models used for assessing the quality of generated responses by large language models. It includes the OffsetBias preference dataset to improve robustness against biases in evaluation.
reputation: A niche meta-evaluation benchmark used mainly for studying judge-model bias rather than a widely adopted general benchmark.
notes: Focuses on debiasing judge models and improving evaluation robustness.
